description.title: Your organisation's AI, working as a group
description.body: iAgents Hub turns agents, people and resources into coordinated work groups. Each group brings together models, LLM orchestrations, workflows, knowledge, prompts, skills and tools with clear ownership and permissions, on a self-hosted platform that keeps you in control of your data.

features.title: An ecosystem built around the group
features.body: Collaboration is not bolted on at the end: the group is the unit that organises access, execution and reuse across the platform.
